title: Tindeco Whitepaper: Scalable customisation is disrupting the investment management industry
主要内容: Tindeco's whitepaper highlights the growing demand for customised investment strategies across all client segments, including institutional and retail investors. The report notes that the trend is supported by increasing demand for investment solutions aligned with clients' values and holistic financial needs. Investment managers are urged to adopt highly systematic approaches to portfolio construction and management, leveraging new technologies to enhance automation and reduce the marginal costs of providing customised mandates to near zero. The whitepaper underscores the shift toward democratizing investment management, enabling clients of all sizes to access tailored portfolios and advice. Tindeco highlights that developments in cloud computing, process automation, machine learning, and distributed ledger technology (DLT) will reduce production costs in investment management, enabling customised, rules-based investment strategies for all market segments. The industry is expected to reorganise around functional needs rather than normative client types, with investment management platforms, expert managers, and customer channels becoming primary segments. Tindeco offers the VISION platform to support asset and wealth managers in implementing scalable operating models for efficient delivery of customised solutions.
